title: API Token Controls
scope: Admin controls, logging and revocation for API credentials on SaaS platforms. Sourced from vendor documentation; not an audit of any tenant.

definitions.conditional: Documented, with plan, policy or endpoint conditions.
definitions.excluded: The named control explicitly does not cover this credential.
definitions.not_supported: Vendor documentation states this credential lacks the control.
definitions.unknown: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_verified: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_applicable: Does not apply to this credential.
definitions.limited: Documented for a narrower case only.

providers.name: CircleCI
providers.scope_notes: Covers CircleCI Cloud. CircleCI cloud (Free, Performance, Scale); SAML SSO and audit log streaming need Scale, context security-group restrictions only on github-type orgs; CircleCI Server is out of scope.

controls.name: Delete project API token
controls.what: Delete a project token (type DELETE to confirm).

controls.name: Project API token scope
controls.what: Choose Status, Read Only or Admin.

controls_unknown: Any org-admin setting to block, list or revoke members' personal API tokens.
Any org setting to disable OAuth Dynamic Client Registration tokens.
Any inbound IP allowlist for the CircleCI API or web app.
Whether personal API token create/delete or API reads appear in audit logs (not in the published event list).
Whether an SSO-authorized token stops working when the IdP session ends or the user is removed from the IdP.

authentication.summary: Per-project token with Status, Read Only or Admin scope; works on API v1 only, not v2.

federation.details: Not tied to a user login.

administration.summary: Created and deleted under Project Settings > API Permissions. Deprecated but still in use.

offboard.details: Project tokens belong to a project, not to a user.

inventory.details: Tokens are listed per project under Project Settings > API Permissions; no org-wide listing is documented.

usage.ui: Org > Security > Audit Logs > Request audit logs > Download logs (CSV); filter action project.api_token.create (no field identifies the token on use)

containment.steps: Delete under Project Settings > API Permissions.

unknown: v1 endpoints usable with project tokens

evidence.title: Pause or stop pipelines during an incident
